title: Nehemiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 11
description: Ten questions on Nehemiah 11: who settled in Jerusalem, the holy city, and in the towns of Judah and Benjamin.

questions.text: The rest of the people cast lots to bring how many to dwell in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: They cast lots to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem, and nine parts in the other cities.
The people blessed all the men who willingly offered themselves to dwell in Jerusalem.

answers.text: The priests who read the law to them
Those who willingly offered to live in Jerusalem
The builders who finished the city wall
The princes who governed the province

questions.text: How many sons of Perez lived in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: All the sons of Perez who lived in Jerusalem were four hundred sixty-eight valiant men.

questions.text: Who was second over the city?
questions.explanation: Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer, and Judah the son of Hassenuah was second over the city.

questions.text: Which two chiefs of the Levites had the oversight of the outward business of God's house?
questions.explanation: Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chiefs of the Levites, had the oversight of the outward business of God's house.

questions.text: What was the role of Mattaniah the son of Mica?
questions.explanation: Mattaniah was the chief to begin the thanksgiving in prayer.

answers.text: Keeper of the watch at the city gates
Overseer of the temple servants in Ophel
Chief to begin the thanksgiving in prayer
Treasurer over the rooms of God's house

questions.text: Where did the temple servants live?
questions.explanation: The temple servants lived in Ophel, and Ziha and Gishpa were over them.

questions.text: According to verse 23, what was there for the singers?
questions.explanation: There was a commandment from the king concerning them, and a settled provision for the singers, as every day required.

answers.text: A commandment from the king and a settled provision
Houses of their own on the hill of Ophel
A share of the land of the children of Benjamin
Freedom from all the work of God's house

questions.text: Who was at the king's hand in all matters concerning the people?
questions.explanation: Pethahiah the son of Meshezabel, of the children of Zerah, was at the king's hand in all matters concerning the people.

questions.text: According to verse 30, from where to where did they encamp?
questions.explanation: After listing their towns, the text says they encamped from Beersheba to the valley of Hinnom.

answers.text: From Dan in the north to Beersheba
From Beersheba to the valley of Hinnom
From Jericho to the river Jordan
From Ophel to the brook Kidron
